name: zerodha-mutual-fund-sell-spanning-the-exit-load-window
describes: A ₹1,00,000 redemption drawn from two FIFO lots of one equity scheme — 600 units held over a year and 400 units held four months. The exit load applies to the younger lot alone, so averaging it over the redemption would charge the older units a load they no longer attract. This is the fixture AC-6 was open for: the load is on the shipped instrument profile, not on any rate card, and the holding period is answered per lot.
